name: ai-crawler-access-2026
title: AI Crawler Access Study: robots.txt and llms.txt of 261 Major Websites (October 2026)
description: Robots.txt and llms.txt of 285 major websites in 10 categories, checked against 14 AI user agents (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot) plus Googlebot as a control. 261 of the 285 robots.txt files could be read. One row per domain, 20 columns. Collected October 2026 by AI Ranked.
